name: Neo4jEnterpriseCluster Phase Lifecycle
description: The top-level lifecycle phase the cluster reconciler drives the CR through, from first-reconcile Initializing to a verified Ready cluster, with Expanding and upgrade-driven Paused/Failed excursions along the way.

states.name: Initializing
states.description: First reconcile after creation; validation, TLS certificate issuance, and RBAC/Service resources are applied before the server StatefulSet is emitted.

states.name: Forming
states.description: Server StatefulSet applied; waiting for Bolt connectivity, a split-brain-free SHOW SERVERS quorum, and for the StatefulSet rollout to fully settle.

states.name: Expanding
states.description: A PVC size increase was detected; volumes are being patched and the StatefulSet orphan-deleted so it can be recreated with the enlarged VolumeClaimTemplates.

states.name: Ready
states.description: Cluster formation is verified, the StatefulSet is fully rolled to the current template, and status.endpoints/status.replicas reflect the live serving cluster.

states.name: Paused
states.description: A rolling-upgrade step failed with upgradeStrategy.autoPauseOnFailure set; the operator stops driving the upgrade until a human intervenes.

states.name: Failed
states.description: A validation, resource-creation, storage-expansion, or rolling-upgrade error occurred; status.message and a Warning event carry the cause, and the next reconcile retries.

transitions.label: TLS/RBAC/Service/ConfigMap/StatefulSet resources reconciled successfully
transitions.condition: no validation, StorageClass, or resource-creation error

transitions.label: spec validation or resource creation failed
transitions.condition: ValidateCreateWithWarnings/ValidateServerRoleHints errors, missing StorageClass, or a resource create/update error

transitions.label: cluster formation and StatefulSet rollout verified
transitions.condition: verifyNeo4jClusterFormation reports the expected Enabled+Available quorum AND serverStatefulSetFullyRolled is true

effects.description: Backfills status.version from spec.image.tag on the first Ready transition if it was never stamped by an upgrade.

transitions.label: formation check itself errored
transitions.condition: verifyNeo4jClusterFormation returns a non-nil error rather than merely reporting 'not yet formed'

transitions.label: storage size increased
transitions.condition: spec.storage.size exceeds at least one live server PVC's current size

transitions.label: storage size increased
transitions.condition: spec.storage.size exceeds at least one live server PVC's current size

transitions.label: PVCs patched, StatefulSet orphan-deleted

effects.description: Each undersized PVC is patched to the desired size.

transitions.label: update validation, storage shrink, or property-sharding validation failed on a later reconcile
transitions.condition: ValidateUpdateWithWarnings errors, a shrink is detected, or property-sharding validation fails

transitions.label: rolling-upgrade step failed with autoPauseOnFailure
transitions.condition: image drift starts an upgrade and a later step's gate/deadline fails while upgradeStrategy.autoPauseOnFailure is true

transitions.label: rolling-upgrade step failed without autoPauseOnFailure
transitions.condition: a rolling-upgrade step's gate/deadline fails and autoPauseOnFailure is not set

transitions.label: corrected spec re-validates
transitions.condition: the underlying validation/resource error is resolved on a later reconcile

name: Rolling Upgrade State Machine
description: The requeue-driven, per-reconcile-step state machine (#174) that performs an in-place image upgrade one ordinal at a time instead of blocking a single reconcile for the whole rollout.

states.name: No Upgrade Active
states.description: status.upgradeStatus is nil or its phase is a terminal Completed/Failed/Paused; the normal reconcile path runs and isUpgradeRequired watches for image drift.

states.name: Staging
states.description: Applies the full target-version pod template (image plus version-correct discovery env) with the StatefulSet partition frozen at replicas, then reconciles the ConfigMap under the same freeze.

states.name: Rolling
states.description: Lowers the StatefulSet partition one ordinal at a time, highest first, gating each step on the Kubernetes rollout AND the restarted server re-appearing as Enabled+Available in SHOW SERVERS.

states.name: Stabilizing
states.description: One-shot post-upgrade health, consensus, and replication gate once every server has rolled to the target version.

states.name: Verifying
states.description: Confirms every Enabled server reports the target version via SHOW SERVERS before declaring the upgrade complete.

states.name: Completed
states.description: Terminal success state: stamps CompletionTime, LastUpgradeTime, and status.version, then flips the cluster's top-level phase back to Ready.

states.name: Failed
states.description: Terminal failure state after a step's deadline or gate is exceeded; isUpgradeRequired can re-enter automatically from image drift if the target and status.version still disagree.

states.name: Paused
states.description: Terminal failure state when upgradeStrategy.autoPauseOnFailure is set; never auto-resumed, requires manual intervention.

states.name: Legacy In-Progress Marker
states.description: The blocking-loop phase marker persisted by pre-#174 operator versions; resumed as Staging the first time a current operator sees it, since Staging is idempotent.

transitions.label: image drift detected on a Ready cluster with no upgrade active
transitions.condition: isUpgradeRequired is true and pre-flight gates (version compatibility, StatefulSet readiness, optional pre-upgrade health check) pass

effects.description: Initializes upgradeStatus with StartTime, PreviousVersion, TargetVersion, and Progress totals.

transitions.label: target template staged, partition frozen, ConfigMap reconciled

effects.description: Records the frozen partition (= replicas) the Rolling phase will lower ordinal by ordinal.

transitions.label: staging timed out or a pre-flight gate failed
lower the partition by one ordinal
transitions.condition: the current ordinal's StatefulSet rollout is settled and it reports Enabled+Available in SHOW SERVERS

effects.description: Decrements the partition by one so the next-lowest ordinal restarts.

transitions.label: partition reached 0 and ordinal 0 verified
an ordinal failed to roll and rejoin within the upgrade timeout
post-upgrade health/consensus/replication check passed (or disabled)
cluster failed to stabilize within the stabilization timeout
every enabled server confirmed running the target version

effects.description: Stamps status.version to the target tag alongside CompletionTime and LastUpgradeTime.

transitions.label: version verification failed to pass before the health-check timeout
image drift persists against an unchanged target
transitions.condition: status.upgradeStatus.targetVersion still equals spec.image.tag and status.version still doesn't match — isUpgradeRequired re-enters

transitions.label: legacy blocking-loop marker resumed on operator restart
upgrade target changed mid-flight
transitions.condition: spec.image.tag was edited again while any active phase (except the legacy marker) was in flight

transitions.label: upgrade target changed mid-flight
transitions.condition: spec.image.tag was edited again during Rolling

transitions.label: upgrade target changed mid-flight
transitions.condition: spec.image.tag was edited again during Stabilizing

transitions.label: upgrade target changed mid-flight
transitions.condition: spec.image.tag was edited again during Verifying

name: Neo4jBackup Job Phase
description: The Job/CronJob lifecycle the Neo4jBackup reconciler drives the CR through, from validation to a recorded backup outcome.

states.name: Pending
states.description: The Neo4jBackup CR was just created or edited; not yet validated against a resolved target.

states.name: Invalid
states.description: The inline BackupValidator (plus replication-source chain rules) rejected the spec; reconciliation halts until it is fixed.

states.name: Waiting
states.description: The spec is valid but the target cluster/standalone has not been found yet, or is not yet Ready.

states.name: Suspended
states.description: spec.suspend=true; any existing CronJob is also suspended and no new backup runs are started.

states.name: Scheduled
states.description: A CronJob exists for spec.schedule and will spawn a child Job on each firing.

states.name: Running
states.description: A backup Job is currently executing neo4j-admin database backup.

states.name: Completed
states.description: The most recent backup Job reached JobComplete and its run was recorded in status.history.

states.name: Failed
states.description: The most recent backup Job reached JobFailed (BackoffLimit exhausted) or its pod never started within the startup deadline.

transitions.label: Inline BackupValidator (plus replication-source chain rules) rejects the spec
Target cluster/standalone not found yet, or not Ready
spec.suspend=true; any existing CronJob is also suspended
spec.suspend flips back to false; CronJob resumed
Target becomes Ready and spec.schedule is set; CronJob created
Target becomes Ready for a one-time backup; Job created
spec.schedule is set; CronJob created/updated
One-time backup; Job created
CronJob spawns a child Job for a scheduled firing
Job reaches JobComplete; the run (with artifact metadata) is recorded in status.history
Job reaches JobFailed (BackoffLimit exhausted), or its pod never starts within the startup deadline

name: Neo4jRestore Phase
description: The resolve-and-execute lifecycle the Neo4jRestore reconciler drives the CR through against a backup or storage source.

states.name: Pending
states.description: The Neo4jRestore CR was just created; the backup/storage source has not yet been resolved.

states.name: Running
states.description: The restore Job is executing (standalone), or the cluster in-place Cypher recreate / all-databases loop is in progress.

states.name: Completed
states.description: The restore Job succeeded (standalone) or the recreated database(s) were confirmed fully online (cluster / all-databases).

states.name: Failed
states.description: The restore Job failed terminally, was TTL-collected before completion was observed, or the online-wait deadline elapsed.

transitions.label: Target found and Ready, backup source resolved; restore Job created or Cypher recreate issued
validateRestore rejects the spec, or the resolved backup source cannot be prepared (seed creds/endpoint not projectable)
Restore Job succeeds (standalone) or the recreated database is confirmed fully online (cluster / all-databases)
Restore Job fails terminally, is TTL-collected before completion is observed, or the online-wait deadline elapses
spec is bumped to a new generation (or the CR is recreated); a Failed CR at the SAME generation never re-enters

name: Neo4jShardedDatabase Phase
description: The validate/create/seed lifecycle the Neo4jShardedDatabase reconciler drives the CR through, including a destructive re-seed excursion.

states.name: Validating
states.description: The Neo4jShardedDatabase spec is being checked by ShardedDatabaseValidator before any Cypher is issued.

states.name: Creating
states.description: Validation passed; the reconciler is checking cluster readiness and about to issue CREATE DATABASE.

states.name: Waiting
states.description: The referenced cluster is not yet Ready with property sharding operational.

states.name: Pending
states.description: Waiting on seedBackupRef's Neo4jBackup to produce a Succeeded run, or on the PVC seed-proxy Deployment to become Ready.

states.name: Failed
states.description: The cluster doesn't support property sharding, seed resolution failed permanently, or CREATE DATABASE itself failed.

states.name: Ready
states.description: CREATE DATABASE succeeded and the graph shard reports online in SHOW DATABASES.

transitions.label: ShardedDatabaseValidator rejects the spec
Validation passes
Referenced cluster isn't yet Ready with property sharding operational
seedBackupRef's Neo4jBackup has no Succeeded run yet, or the PVC seed proxy isn't Ready
Cluster doesn't support property sharding, seed resolution fails permanently, or CREATE DATABASE fails
CREATE DATABASE succeeds and the graph shard reports online
spec.replaceExisting+force re-triggers a destructive drop+recreate at a new generation

name: Neo4jReplicaPromotion Phase
description: The one-shot check-promote-check-record lifecycle the Neo4jReplicaPromotion reconciler drives the CR through.

states.name: Pending
states.description: The Neo4jReplicaPromotion CR was just created; the referenced Neo4jReplicaDatabase has not yet been checked.

states.name: Promoting
states.description: The live database was confirmed type=replica and the irreversible PromoteReplicaDatabase call has been issued.

states.name: Completed
states.description: A post-promote CHECK confirmed the database's type is no longer replica; the promotion is recorded as terminal.

states.name: Failed
states.description: The referenced Neo4jReplicaDatabase/database does not exist, so the promotion cannot proceed.

transitions.label: Referenced Neo4jReplicaDatabase resolved, target Ready, live database confirmed type=replica; the promote call is issued
The referenced database does not exist
The live database is already promoted (idempotent recovery from a prior attempt that crashed before recording)
A post-promote CHECK confirms the database's type is no longer replica
The promote call failed or could not be confirmed; re-checked (never re-issued) on the next reconcile

name: Neo4jUser reconcile lifecycle
description: status.phase transitions (Pending/Failed/Ready) plus the ClusterNotReady, PendingDependencies, RolesSynced, and PasswordSynced named conditions driven each reconcile loop, and the deletion path guarded by the neo4j.com/user-finalizer.

states.name: New
states.description: The Neo4jUser CR was just created; no reconcile has run yet.

states.name: Pending
states.description: status.phase=Pending — set on a missing/not-ready cluster target, a not-yet-applied password Secret, or roles not yet fully synced (ConditionTypePendingDependencies/ConditionTypeRolesSynced=False).

states.name: Failed
states.description: status.phase=Failed — set on validator errors, a Bolt connection failure, or any create/alter/grant/revoke error (EventReasonUserSyncFailed).

states.name: Ready
states.description: status.phase=Ready — set when granted roles equal spec.roles and no roles are missing (ConditionReasonUserReady); ConditionTypeRolesSynced and ConditionTypePasswordSynced are True.

states.name: Deleting
states.description: metadata.deletionTimestamp is set; the neo4j.com/user-finalizer is still present and DROP USER is pending.

states.name: DeletionFailed
states.description: DROP USER failed but was classified retryable (classifyFinalizerCleanup); the reconcile requeues and retries instead of releasing the finalizer.

states.name: Removed
states.description: The finalizer is released and the Neo4jUser CR is deleted from the API server — after a successful DROP USER, a Retain deletionPolicy, a missing cluster target, or a non-retryable cleanup failure.

transitions.label: Finalizer added; first reconcile requeued
ValidationFailed — UserValidator.Validate returned field errors
SecretPending — password Secret not yet applied (#259, apply order irrelevant)
ClusterNotFound — clusterRef target does not exist
ClusterNotReady (ConditionTypeClusterNotReady=True) — target cluster/standalone not Ready
ConnectionFailed — NewClient() Bolt connection error
UserSyncFailed — lookup/create/alter/grant/revoke error via r.fail()
RolesPending (ConditionTypePendingDependencies=True, ConditionTypeRolesSynced=False) — a desired role is missing or not yet granted
UserReady (ConditionReasonUserReady) — granted roles equal spec.roles, no missing roles
RolesPending — a later spec.roles edit reopens a role gap
UserSyncFailed — a subsequent reconcile hits a create/alter/grant/revoke error
metadata.deletionTimestamp set
metadata.deletionTimestamp set
metadata.deletionTimestamp set
DeletionPolicy=Retain — finalizer released without dropping the user
ClusterNotFound during deletion — target already gone, finalizer released
UserDeleted — DROP USER succeeded, finalizer released
UserDeletionFailed (retryable) — DROP USER failed, will retry
UserDeletionFailed — repeated retry on requeue
UserDeleted — a later retry of DROP USER succeeds
UserDeletionFailed (non-retryable) — cleanup gives up, finalizer released to avoid wedging deletion

name: AuraInstance Phase Lifecycle
description: The status-poll state machine the AuraInstance reconciler drives the CR through against the remote Aura API's own instance lifecycle.

states.name: Creating
states.description: CreateInstance/CreateInstanceV2 was called and the operator is waiting for the first GetInstance observation to confirm the instance is running.

states.name: Running
states.description: The Aura instance is up and serving; drift patches and pause/upgrade requests are evaluated from this state.

states.name: Pausing
states.description: PauseInstance was called in response to spec.paused=true; waiting for Aura to report the instance paused.

states.name: Paused
states.description: The Aura instance is paused; only a resume request or deletion is evaluated from this state.

states.name: Resuming
states.description: ResumeInstance was called in response to spec.paused=false; waiting for Aura to report the instance running again.

states.name: Updating
states.description: A drift-correcting PatchInstance or a tier UpgradeInstance call is in flight.

states.name: Deleting
states.description: The CR was deleted with deletionPolicy=Delete; DeleteInstance has been called and the finalizer is pending release.

states.name: Failed
states.description: A non-transient, non-conflict error occurred during create, observe, patch, or upgrade; fail() set Ready=False.

transitions.label: CreateInstance/CreateInstanceV2 succeeds and the first GetInstance observation satisfies aura.IsInstanceRunning
spec.paused=true drives reconcilePauseResume to call PauseInstance
a later GetInstance observation satisfies aura.IsInstancePaused
spec.paused=false drives reconcilePauseResume to call ResumeInstance
a later GetInstance observation satisfies aura.IsInstanceRunning again
reconcileDrift issues PatchInstance, or reconcileUpgrade issues UpgradeInstance (professional-db to business-critical)
GetInstance observes aura.IsInstanceRunning once the patch or upgrade converges
the CR is deleted with deletionPolicy=Delete, triggering handleDeletion to call DeleteInstance
observeOrCreate/CreateInstance returns a non-transient error; fail() sets Ready=False
GetInstance or PatchInstance/UpgradeInstance returns a non-transient, non-conflict error; fail() sets Ready=False

name: AuraDatabase Phase Lifecycle
description: The simpler create/observe status flow for a database on a multi-database Aura instance.

states.name: Pending
states.description: The database has not yet been resolved/created, or the last GetDatabase observation failed.

states.name: Ready
states.description: observeOrCreate resolved or created the database and the most recent GetDatabase call succeeded.

states.name: Error
states.description: TargetUnresolved, CreateFailed (including InstanceNotMultiDatabase), or ObserveFailed; fail() set status.phase=Error.

transitions.label: observeOrCreate resolves or creates the database and GetDatabase succeeds; syncStatus sets status.phase=Ready
TargetUnresolved, CreateFailed (including InstanceNotMultiDatabase) or ObserveFailed; fail() sets status.phase=Error
a later reconcile's GetDatabase call fails; fail() sets status.phase=Error
a later reconcile succeeds again; syncStatus overwrites status.phase=Ready
